claim:
Let \(A=(\mathbb R^2,\|\cdot\|_A)\) be the real regular-octagonal plane
\[
\|(u,v)\|_A=\max\left\{|u|+(\sqrt2-1)|v|,\ |v|+(\sqrt2-1)|u|\right\}.
\]
For the Baronti--Franchetti parameter
\[
\Lambda(A)=\inf_{x,y\in S_A}\sup_{f\in S_{A^*}}\min\{|f(x)|,|f(y)|\},
\]
one has
\[
\Lambda(A)=\frac{\sqrt2}{1+\sqrt{\,4-2\sqrt2\,}}=0.679129302431368\ldots .
\]
If \(a=\sqrt2-1\), \(s=\sqrt{4-2\sqrt2}\), and \(r_0=a/(1+s)\), then equality is attained by the isosceles-orthogonal pair
\[
x_0=\left(\frac1s,\frac{r_0}{s}\right),\qquad
y_0=\left(-\frac{r_0}{s},\frac1s\right),
\]
and by its images under the norm symmetries.
integrity: The proof derives the isosceles-pair value independently from segment distance and explicit dual functionals, then uses a complete four-cone reduction to arbitrary unit pairs. Exact symbolic checks verify the critical radical identities.
scientific_limitations: The exact value is specific to the regular octagonal plane studied by Baronti and Franchetti. No formula is claimed for arbitrary regular polygons or larger octagonal families. A later differently notated restatement remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact Baronti--Franchetti parameter of the regular octagonal plane
